dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence and sharp boundary sharpness; distinct pale grayish-white edges contrast sharply against dark brownish-gray flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and linear color transition boundary separating the uniform brown-gray crown/nape from the high-contrast scaled texture of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Strong visual contrast between a pale cream throat and the darker ocular stripe and uniform brown crown.
